cold: #197's cold test: written before the pose, from the sources alone. Don't read it while posing this lift, and tune neither to the other.
sources: docs/research/grip.md: finger base at the top, mid-fingers at the bottom, the wrist through its own range

lines.says: the wrist bends through a real range at both ends
the wrist joint stays in place: only the hand moves
the hand doesn't roll about the forearm
the body holds a deep squat
the palms face up, the hand curling up toward the forearm at one end and hanging back at the other
at the hanging end the bar rolls down into the fingers
the forearms rest on the thighs, the hands past the knees
the bar runs from a low pulley in front of the lifter, both hands on it
